continuity.campaign_development: January 60 BCE: Valerius halted the march to recover his exhausted soldiers. He spent a day speaking personally with the men while rotating patrols guarded the position. Earthworks, a small watchtower and a secure storehouse were constructed. By month end exhaustion reached 0 and supply reached 48 before the next march.
